**Climate Explorer: Bioclimatic Data App**

This interactive app lets you extract and visualize WorldClim bioclimatic variables for any set of sample coordinates.  
You can upload your own CSV file or use the provided example data (Arabidopsis thaliana accessions from Spain and Sweden).  
Plot your samples on a map, color them by any climate variable, and explore correlations among all extracted variables.  


[Open in a new tab](https://tahirali-biomics2.shinyapps.io/climate-explorer-app/)

[← Back to Interactive Apps](interactive.html)

> **Features:**
> - Upload a CSV of sample coordinates or use example data.
> - Extract 19 WorldClim bioclimatic variables for each sample.
> - Visualize samples on a map, colored by any selected climate variable.
> - Explore a correlation heatmap of all climate variables, with full variable names.
> - Download the full data table as a CSV.
